name: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live
description: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live is Google's low-latency, real-time speech-to-text model for bidirectional streaming audio transcription over WebSockets.

details.name: catalog_note
details.value: Transcribes live audio streams with custom vocabulary support and sub-second latency for interactive voice agents, captioning, and translation layers.

details.name: session_limit
details.value: Up to 10 minutes per Live API session.

details.name: feature_limits
details.value: Word-level timestamps and speaker diarization are not supported for live streaming.

sources.notes: Google DeepMind documents realtime streaming transcription, WebSocket Live API usage, and the Gemini 3.5 Transcribe model family.
Google's Gemini API model index publishes the exact endpoint gemini-3.5-transcribe-live.

verification.notes: Identity, endpoint, realtime speech-to-text role, and token limits verified against Google's current DeepMind transcription page and Gemini API model index.
